title: The Unofficial Playlist
author: Theo Hartwell
blurb: Cyrus Hartwell, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. But when the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before prom.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
